style_preamble: Use case: stylized-concept. Production Idlever gothic moonlit game art, painted pixel hybrid: coarse stepped pixel clusters, watercolor grain inside, strong hand-inked blue-black silhouette. Palette INK #0d0c14 UMBRA #1c1b2b DUSK #2b3350 MOON #4d6c99 MIST #a4bcd6 BONE #eadfc5 BLOOD #c01530 CLOT #5c0b1c sparse GILT #b89448, EMBER only flames. Cold moonlight above. No text, logos, glossy 3D, gradients or chibi.

jobs.brief: The hero, the CLOWN class: a worn gothic COURT FOOL, a dark-fantasy jester — NOT a circus clown, NOT comic, NO face paint, NO red nose, NO rainbow colours. A light poised stance on the balls of the feet, slightly turned, one heel lifted, elegant and unsettling. MOTLEY doublet and hose quartered in INK and DUSK (two dark tones in a harlequin split, a small diamond pattern only on the doublet), ONE BLOOD diamond lozenge on the chest (the only motley BLOOD); an angular two-pointed split FOOL'S CAP (INK and DUSK halves, the points curling forward and down) with ONE small GILT BELL at each tip; a short ruffled BONE collar ruff; in the right hand a DAGGER held low and reversed (MIST edge rim); from the left hand a hand-BELL LURE swings on a short cord (a dull GILT bell, the decoy the fool plants); a LONG tattered BLOOD #c01530 cloak (CLOT #5c0b1c folds) trailing behind — every hero wears it. TAG: the split two-pointed belled cap above a slim figure, plus the swinging bell — readable as 'fool' in silhouette alone, clearly distinct from the rogue's low crouch and the caster's staff. LOOK = MAN: a young man, SHORT dark hair (nothing past the collar), broad shoulders; a clear pale BONE FACE patch in three-quarter view (narrow gothic-anime eyes, a few ink strokes). At game size he reads as a man by the short hair and square frame.

The hero, the ENGINEER class: a gothic TINKERER, a field engineer — NOT steampunk-cute, NO top hat, NO gears on the clothes everywhere. A planted upright stance, weight forward, practical. A long dark leather WORK COAT (UMBRA/DUSK) to the knees over a heavy leather APRON with a few tool loops, restrained GILT brass buckles and rivets; brass-rimmed round GOGGLES pushed UP on the forehead (two MIST lens glints high on the figure); thick gloves; a heavy flanged iron MACE held in the right hand, its head low and forward (MIST rim on the flanges); a big iron WRENCH hung at the belt; on the back a folded iron SENTRY TRIPOD (three legs over the shoulder, a squat turret head peeking above the left shoulder) — the construct the engineer deploys; a LONG tattered BLOOD #c01530 cloak (CLOT #5c0b1c folds) trailing behind the coat. TAG: the mace + the tripod legs over the shoulder + goggles on the brow — readable as 'engineer' in silhouette alone, clearly distinct from the fighter's shield and the gunner's rifle. a plain village BENCH where a resting hero sits by the recovery pool: one thick weathered wooden PLANK seat on two squat fieldstone or timber legs, no back rest, wide and low (about 3:1), the seat top a broad pale MIST-lit plank so it reads as a flat seat from above, the legs and front edge in UMBRA/DUSK; seen from the town's high three-quarter camera (the top and the front both visible, the front facing the viewer and slightly to the lower-left, exactly like town_blacksmith_1.png and town_storehouse_1.png), INK line and washes on the pixel grid, standing on nothing. The long flat lit seat is the tag. No person on it, no cushion, no BLOOD, no EMBER.

a small hand-carried iron LANTERN: a square INK iron cage with a MOON top cap and a ring handle on top, four dark glass panes and a warm EMBER flame inside (a BONE core, the only warm colour), a GILT base plate; upright and slightly taller than wide; seen from the town's high three-quarter camera (the top and the front both visible, the front facing the viewer and slightly to the lower-left, exactly like town_blacksmith_1.png and town_storehouse_1.png), INK line and washes on the pixel grid, standing on nothing. The glowing pane in the dark cage is the tag. No post, no hand, no glow halo outside the cage (the game adds the light pool).

the GUILD HALL (where the scout and the workers are hired), a medieval guildhouse: a tall STEEP gable of dark overlapping SLATE courses (the gable end facing the viewer, the long roof receding to the upper-right, MIST moonlit ridge), timber-framed walls of warm grey plaster held by dark timber posts and diagonal braces, a fieldstone foundation course; a recessed ARCHED wooden door on the gable front, a small notice board with two pinned BONE papers (blank, no writing) beside it, a small hanging square signboard on an iron bracket (blank, no letters, no symbol), one side window with a warm EMBER glow and a small EMBER lamp at the corner; seen from the town's high three-quarter camera (the top and the front both visible, the front facing the viewer and slightly to the lower-left, exactly like town_blacksmith_1.png and town_storehouse_1.png), INK line and washes on the pixel grid, standing on nothing. The steep slate gable over the timber frame is the tag: it must read 'guild hall', not a church, not a house with a chimney, no steeple, no cross.

the RECOVERY POOL (where returned heroes rest): a wide shallow OVAL pool rimmed by about fourteen interlocking wedge-shaped fieldstone blocks (each block a separate lit-topped stone with dark seams, a SEGMENTED ring, not a smooth ring), dark still water inside stepping down in two or three bands from MOON at the near edge to DUSK/UMBRA at the far side, two small MIST ripple glints, a few low stone steps on the near rim, small tufts of moss between stones; seen from the town's high three-quarter camera (the top and the front both visible, the front facing the viewer and slightly to the lower-left, exactly like town_blacksmith_1.png and town_storehouse_1.png), INK line and washes on the pixel grid, standing on nothing. The segmented stone oval around dark water is the tag. No fountain, no statue, no spout, no steam, no bathers.

a resident's STATION by the clone vat: a low flat round iron-rimmed STONE PAD set into the ground, a dark DUSK disc inside a thick grey iron ring with a single MIST rim highlight along its top edge and one thin MIST line across it (a seam), nearly flat, seen from above at the town camera (a wide ellipse); seen from the town's high three-quarter camera (the top and the front both visible, the front facing the viewer and slightly to the lower-left, exactly like town_blacksmith_1.png and town_storehouse_1.png), INK line and washes on the pixel grid, standing on nothing. It must read as a flat round pad, nothing standing on it, no glyphs, no light.

the CLOWN insignia: an angular two-pointed split FOOL'S CAP seen
   front-on, one half BONE and one half INK-dark with a MIST rim, both points curling outward and down, a small round GILT bell at
   each tip, and ONE small BLOOD #c01530 diamond on the cap band (the only red). A gothic court fool's cap, NOT a circus clown, no
   face, no mask, no rainbow.

the CLOWN's BELL LURE: a thin dark INK iron POST (a
   shepherd's-crook top bending right) planted in a small three-stone footing, a dull GILT BELL hanging from the crook with a BONE
   highlight and an INK clapper showing under its mouth, and a small split swallowtail BLOOD #c01530 PENNANT flying from the post top
   (the only red; CLOT in its fold). Tall, thin, asymmetric: the bell and the pennant are the tag. Fills ~70 % of the height.

the ENGINEER's SENTRY: a squat riveted iron TURRET head (a
   rounded box in DUSK/MOON steel washes with MIST rims on its top edge) on a splayed iron TRIPOD (three thick INK legs spreading wide
   to the floor), a short thick BARREL pointing RIGHT, one round cold MIST LENS on the turret front, a thin GILT collar where the head
   meets the tripod. Squat and wide, symmetric legs: the tripod and barrel are the tag. Fills ~75 % of the width.
